A ticket carrying neither field validate: treats a ticket with neither epic nor blocked_on as clean (fields optional)
An unresolvable blocked_on id is warned,: warns on a dangling blocked_on, a cycle, and a self-cycle, zero-exit
A blocked_on cycle is warned, not errore: warns on a dangling blocked_on, a cycle, and a self-cycle, zero-exit
A self-referential blocked_on is warned: warns on a dangling blocked_on, a cycle, and a self-cycle, zero-exit
A clean corpus produces no relation advi: stays silent for valid blocked_on relations
Advancing out of intake is denied while: denies advancing out of intake while a blocker is in_progress
Advancing out of intake is allowed once: allows the advance once the blocker is done
Any non-done blocker among several denie: denies when any of several blockers is not done
All-done blockers allow the advance: allows when all blockers are done
A blocker with unreadable status fails s: fails safe (denies) when a blocker has an unreadable status
A cancelled blocker without an override: denies a cancelled blocker with no override
A substantive override allows advance pa: allows past a cancelled blocker with a substantive override
An override's reason is surfaced in the: surfaces the override reason in the INDEX
A stale override is flagged once every b: warns that a blocked_on_override is stale once every blocker is done
A blocker added after intake does not re: does not block a phase advance that is not leaving intake (grandfather)
A non-phase edit is never blocked: allows a non-phase edit even while a blocker is unmet
The gate short-circuits on a cycle inste: denies (does not loop) when blocked_on forms a cycle
